sentences.text:
Sandeep Dangi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:37245
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Devnarayan Mishra

On The 8 th Of August, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 30633 of 2025
 Sandeep Dangi
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Ms. Gayatri Ladhiya - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Amit Bhurrak - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/S
 Order

This is the fifth bail application filed by the applicants under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023/Section 439 of Cr.P.C., 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.781 of 2023 registered at Police Station- Banda, District-Sagar (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376 and 306 of IPC.

The applicant is in custody since 23.02.2024.
2.

Applicant's earlier bail applications i.e. M.Cr.C. No.24233/2024, M.Cr.C. No.35984/2024,
M.Cr.C. No.51393/2024 and M.Cr.C. No.14552/2025 were dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 02.07.2024, 30.09.2024, 08.01.2025 and 19.05.2025, respectively.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has argued the case on merit but the facts on which basis the bail is argued, were already on record at the time of presenting earlier four bail applications and the co-ordinate Bench of this NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:37245 2 MCRC-30633-2025 Court considering all the aspects, has dismissed the bail application.
4. Therefore, this Court does not deem it fit to interfere in the concurrent order passed by co-ordinate Bench, hence, the fifth bail application filed by the applicant stands dismissed.
5. Looking to the above factual aspect, the trial Court is requested to conclude the trial as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of six months from today.

(DEVNARAYAN MISHRA) JUDGE AT Sandeep Dangi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/58193576/
